subject: How to create a button in R shiny to run the sql query?

messages.author: b5f801dbd6464f10
messages.subject: How to create a button in R shiny to run the sql query?
parts:
Hi All,
I am new in shiny am looking for help who can able to run the query when we hit the button.
Below is my code please provide any refer or help if possible.
 
Please check if i am doing something wrong in this code?
 
Here is my code:-
 
ui.R
 
library(shiny)
shinyUI(
 
  pageWithSidebar(
   
    headerPanel("Execution"),
    sidebarPanel(
      textInput("id", "Enter NG below"),
      actionButton("action","Run!")
    ),
    mainPanel(
      tabsetPanel(
        tableOutput("tbTable")
      )
    )
  )
)
 
server.R
 
library(shiny)
library(DBI)
library(RODBC)
conn <- odbcConnect("xyz", uid="abc", pwd="abc", rows_at_time = 500)  
shinyServer(function(input, output){
 
  tbTable <- eventReactive(input$action {sqlQuery(conn, "SELECT (substring (ARTCL_PROD_XREF.PCS_CD, 1, 2)) AS PCS_CAT_CD,ARTCL_PROD_XREF.PROD_ID as NG_ITEM_NUM,ARTCL_PROD_XREF.ARTCL_NUM AS ARTCL_NO,OUTBND_ORD_DELV.RCV_CUST_NUM as WHLSL_CUST_NUM,(substring (OUTBND_ORD_DELV_LINE.SHIP_SITE_NUM,3,2)) as SHIP_FROM_DC_NUM,year(OUTBND_ORD_DELV.SHIP_DT) as Y, Week(OUTBND_ORD_DELV.SHIP_DT) as W,OUTBND_ORD_DELV_LINE.ACTL_DELV_SL_QTY as Ship_Qty_Cases, OUTBND_ORD_DELV.SHIP_DT as shipmentdate,OUTBND_ORD_DELV.PLN_DELV_DT as planned_delv
                                      FROM RLDMPROD_TSV.ARTCL_PROD_XREF LEFT JOIN RLDMPROD_TSV.OUTBND_ORD_DELV_LINE ON  ARTCL_PROD_XREF.ARTCL_NUM = OUTBND_ORD_DELV_LINE.ARTCL_NUM and ARTCL_PROD_XREF.EXP_DT = '9999-12-31' LEFT JOIN RLDMPROD_TSV.OUTBND_ORD_DELV ON OUTBND_ORD_DELV_LINE.ORD_DELV_NUM = OUTBND_ORD_DELV.ORD_DELV_NUM WHERE year(OUTBND_ORD_DELV.SHIP_DT) = 2015 and (substring (ARTCL_PROD_XREF.PCS_CD, 1, 2)) in (38,39,42,40,43,44,46,47,48,51,54,55,57,60,77,96,37,95) and week(OUTBND_ORD_DELV.SHIP_DT) in (44)
                                      and OUTBND_ORD_DELV_LINE.ACTL_DELV_SL_QTY>=0 and (substring (OUTBND_ORD_DELV_LINE.SHIP_SITE_NUM,3,2)) in (3,4,6,14,15,16,18,20,21,22,24,28,31,32,34,35,37,49,57,60,61,66,67,72) AND NG_ITEM_NUM = ",input$id,"
                                      GROUP BY ARTCL_PROD_XREF.PCS_CD,ARTCL_PROD_XREF.PROD_ID,ARTCL_PROD_XREF.ARTCL_NUM ,OUTBND_ORD_DELV.RCV_CUST_NUM,OUTBND_ORD_DELV_LINE.SHIP_SITE_NUM, year(OUTBND_ORD_DELV.SHIP_DT),Week(OUTBND_ORD_DELV.SHIP_DT),OUTBND_ORD_DELV_LINE.ACTL_DELV_SL_QTY,OUTBND_ORD_DELV.PLN_DELV_DT,OUTBND_ORD_DELV.SHIP_DT,OUTBND_ORD_DELV.PLN_DELV_DT")
   
  })
   output$tbTable <- renderTable(
     {
       tbTable()
     }
   )
   
})
 
Thanks & Best Regards,
Rahul Namdev

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: How to create a button in R shiny to run the sql query?
parts:
eventReactive is right, you're just missing a comma after input$action.

You should definitely verify that input$id is actually a number, e.g. use as.numeric(input$id) instead; or else you risk SQL injection. Anything in the "input" object should be considered potentially hostile user input!
